judge.rationale: The candidate Appears to have stopped mid-implementation (leaving `.lore/dod.md` in the tree with unchecked items). While the core `ajv` validation and WeakMap caching in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` works for basic cases, it fails to emit the required log line naming the failing property paths on validation failure, and its `new (Ajv.default || Ajv)` expression violates TypeScript/ESLint rules when `NodeNext` module resolution is used (`import {Ajv} from 'ajv'` is required). Furthermore, the candidate is missing several required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` (extra properties passthrough, dynamic schema changes, unknown tool error, compile count check) and the test in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`. Finally, none of the required documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`) were made, and `CHANGELOG.md` only partially describes `register` rather than `execute`.
